title: Check Out the Full Schedule for AMC's Best Christmas Ever 2026
summary: With over 500 hours of festive programming, AMC’s Best Christmas Ever lineup has something for everyone, and is the exclusive broadcast cable home in December for modern-day beloved classics including including National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, Elf, Fred Claus, Four Christmases, Scrooged, White Christmas and much more.
body_markdown:
AMC Global Media continues its tradition of making the season bright with an invite to celebrate the most wonderful time of year with the return of the annual “Best Christmas Ever” programming event beginning November 30 and running through December 26. With over 500 hours of holiday films, AMC’s signature jolly lineup has something for everyone, and remains the exclusive cable home for popular modern-day favorites including


***Elf*** ,


***National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation*** ,


***The Polar Express** , **Four Christmases*** and


***Fred Claus*** this December. The month-long festive programming event also features beloved classics including


***White Christmas*** and the family favorite film,


***The Wizard of Oz*** .


On AMC+, the” Naughty and Nice” list features titles such as the new romantic drama series


***Mix Tape*** starring **Teresa Palmer** and **Jim Sturgess**


*,* **** and the streaming debut of feature-length romantic dramedy


***The Sun Never Sets*** , starring **Dakota Fanning** for the pure hearted. **** While the mischievous can indulge in darker titles like the apocalyptic horror-comedy


***Silent Night*** (2021), starring **Keira Knightley** and **Matthew Goode** and the bawdy


***Christmas with the Campbells*** starring **Brittany Snow** and **Justin Long** . These join other favorites including Rankin/Bass tiles


*The Year Without A Santa Claus, 'Twas the Night Before Christmas, Rudolph's Shiny New Year, Frosty's Winter Wonderland, Rudolph And Frosty's Christmas In July* , and star-led classics such as Deck the Halls with **Matthew Broderick** and **Danny DeVito** and **Rob Lowe’s**


*The Christmas Shoes* .


Viewers are also invited to settle in for holiday themed nights on AMC with the merriest movie lineups (times are ET/PT):


- **Christmas All The Way Marathon** takes viewers on a joyful journey featuring


*Elf, The Polar Express* ,


*The Wizard of Oz* and


*Fred Claus* on December 5 beginning at 5pm.


- **Make It Merry Marathon** highlights our favorite holiday merry-makers on December 6 beginning at 6pm featuring ****


*National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, Elf* and


*Scrooged.*
- **Christmas Candy Marathon** on December 9 beginning at 6pm celebrates some of John Candy’s greatest films including


*Uncle Buck, The Great Outdoors,* and


*Planes, Trains & Automobiles.*
- **Stay-Cation Christmas Marathon** on December 11 beginning at 1pm invites viewers to stay home with the Griswold Family featuring


*National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, National Lampoon’s European Vacation, Vegas Vacation* and


*National Lampoon’s Vacation.*
- **Elf on the TwELFth** on December 12 beginning at 6pm back-to-back 6-hour marathon of modern-day classic


*Elf.*


- **Merry ‘80s Marathon** relives the decade that was merry and bright on December 13 beginning at 2:45pm, featuring


*National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, Uncle Buck, Scrooged, Planes, Trains & Automobiles* and


*The Great Outdoors.*
- **Naughty or Nice Weekend** on December 18 beginning at 6pm through December 20 features films on Santa’s lists including


*Elf, National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, Scrooged, The Polar Express, Four Christmases, Red One* and more.


- **Best Christmas Marathon** from December 24 through December 25 features AMC’s classic 48-hours of holiday favorites including


*Elf, National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, Scrooged, Fred Claus, Red One* and more.


- **Holiday Hangover** recovery begins with one last dose of cheer on December 26 beginning at 8:15am including


*Elf, National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, Four Christmases, Red One* and


*Scrooged* .


Viewers can also stream all-new holiday-themed episodes and specials including Acorn TV’s


***The Madame Blanc Mysteries*** Christmas special and festive documentary


***Nordic Train at Christmas*** , as well as


***Love After Lockup Home For the Holidays*** on All Reality. For horror fans, Shudder has a dark twist on the holiday season with new films


***Unholy Night*** and


***Red Snow*** , plus new specials including


***Joe Bob Conquers Christmas*** and a new holiday episode of ****


***The Haunted Season*** .


Original holiday streaming highlights across AMC Global Media in chronological order:


***The Haunted Season “*** **The Fated Hour”**


**Special Debuts December 1 on Shudder**


From renowned author and filmmaker Kier-La Janisse (


*Woodlands Dark and Days Bewitched: A History of Folk Horror* ),


*The Haunted Season* is a series of chilling horror tales following the classic tradition of telling ghost stories for Christmas. The festive new episode in the horror anthology series,


*The Fated Hour* , it’s Austria, 1810 and on the eve of her wedding, Florentine recounts to her bridegroom the strange and melancholy story of her sister Seraphine's life and death — and the dark legacy she left behind.


***Love After Lockup: Home for the Holidays*** **(We TV Original Special)**


**New Special Premieres Friday, December 4 at 9pm ET on We TV and All Reality**


Fan-favorite cast members from the popular Love After Lockup series dish on the holidays in and out of prison. Justin and Michael go overboard, Kim and Joey face a crisis, Monique doubts Titus, Felicia sets the record straight, and Damond’s love triangle with GG and Bonita pops off.


***Unholy Night*** **(Shudder Original Film)**


**New Film Premieres Friday, December 4 on Shudder**


Gino’s traditional family Christmas Eve turns into a bloody battle for survival when his long-dead grandma drops by and goes on a murderous rampage. Amid the chaos, Gino reunites with his ex and the dysfunctional duo must avoid his dead Italian relatives popping up all around the neighborhood as they search for a way to get rid of these Yuletide revenants and survive his family Christmas. Starring Marc Bendavid (


*Dark Matter* ,


*Reacher* ) and Shailene Garnett (


*Fire Country* ,


*Diggstown* ).


***Joe Bob Conquers Christmas*** **(Shudder Original Special)**


**New Christmas Special Premieres LIVE on Shudder TV Friday, December 4; Streaming On-Demand Beginning Sunday December 6**


Deck the halls with bones and bodies for


*Joe Bob Conquers Christmas!* Horror legends Joe Bob Briggs and Darcy the Mail Girl ring in the festive season with two Christmas classics that "ruined" the holiday upon release - all while raising money through their annual charity fundraiser.


***Nordic Train at Christmas*** **(Acorn TV Special)**


**New Documentary Special Premieres Monday, December 7 on Acorn TV**


Narrated by Hugh Bonneville, this one-hour documentary special goes behind-the-scenes of the Bergenbanen, one of the most beautiful train journeys in the world. Spanning 290 miles between Bergen and Oslo in Norway, the railway, built in 1909, travels through 182 tunnels and provides breathtaking views ranging from calm Fjords in the mountains to snowy vistas in Finse. Viewers are invited aboard the forest green train for an intimate look into the lives of those who reside and work along the route of the Bergen Line.


***Mix Tape*** **(AMC+ Exclusive Series)**


**New Series Premieres Thursday, December 10 on AMC+**


*Mix Tape* follows Alison (Teresa Palmer) and Daniel (Jim Sturgess), whose teenage romance is shaped by their shared love of music and dreams of life beyond their hometown. Twenty years later, they find themselves living on opposite sides of the world and leading very different lives. When an unexpected reunion brings them back together, Alison and Daniel must confront the choices, heartbreak and enduring feelings that have stayed with them for decades.


***Red Snow*** **(Shudder Original Film)**


**New Film Premieres Friday, December 11 on Shudder**


In Finland, sixteen-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti - a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. When Johanna crosses paths with Martti on Christmas Eve, she thinks her dark fairy tale has come true. But instead of eternal romance, she finds herself trapped in a bloody and horrific nightmare of family trauma and festive slaughter. By morning, the snow will turn red.


***The Sun Never Sets*** **(AMC+ Exclusive Film)**


**New Series Premieres Friday, December 18 on AMC+**


A woman’ relationhip with her older divorced husband hits a rough patch just as her ex reappears in her life, leading to complicated emotions and messy entanglements in the Alaskan wilderness. Starring Dakota Fanning, Jake Johnson and Debby Ryan.


***The Madame Blanc Mysteries*** **Christmas Special (Acorn TV Original)**


**Season 5 Finale Premieres Monday, December 21**


The fifth season of ****


*The Madame Blanc Mysteries* culminates in an all-new Christmas Special serving as the season finale. In the episode titled “Till Death Do Us Part” set during Christmas Eve, Jean ( **Sally** **Lindsay,**


*Cold Call* ,


*Love Rat* ) and Dom’s ( **Steve Edge,**


*Starlings, Murder They Hope* ,


*Maxine* ) wedding plans unravel as arrangements are mysteriously canceled and their hired vintage car is stolen. While friends scramble to save the day for them, Jean suspects someone is trying to stop the ceremony.
